headline: AI Engineering Leader
Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
Hands-On Architect
hero.intro: I'm a hands-on AI engineering leader who turns complex business problems into production software. I design and build enterprise AI applications, agentic workflows, multi-agent systems, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, and I've worked at every stage: architecture, rapid prototyping, hands-on development, and production delivery. I still build the systems myself, and I bring the leadership experience to guide global engineering teams and work directly with executive stakeholders.

paragraphs: I'm an engineering leader who never stopped building. I spent 33 years at Boston Consulting Group across several roles, finishing as Senior Software Engineering Manager at BCG X. There I served as Global Topic Lead for Rapid Prototyping and led and mentored globally distributed engineering teams of 15+.

Most of my career has been spent working directly with Fortune 500 clients in manufacturing, healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and other industries: finding the real problem, designing the solution, building the MVP, and delivering the production application. I'm a full-stack engineer at heart, most at home in Python, TypeScript, React, FastAPI, and cloud architectures. Lately my focus has been generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, and enterprise integrations.

Along the way I received BCG's Innovator Award and two Career Coach Star Awards, and I've coached 800+ small-business owners on practical AI adoption. I care as much about why something matters to the business as how it gets built.

projects.title: Enterprise Multi-Agent Negotiation Platform
projects.summary: A multi-agent AI application that supports vendor negotiations, with specialized agents working across the process and people approving the decisions that matter.
projects.challenge: A major U.S. retailer wanted to improve vendor negotiations and support better commercial decisions through AI-driven analysis and coordinated agent workflows.
projects.role: I helped architect and build the solution, including the agent orchestration, the integrations, and the overall application architecture.
solution: Multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph, with agents handling specialized tasks and coordinating across multiple steps
Tool use through APIs and enterprise system integrations
Human oversight and approval for consequential actions
projects.result: A 21% improvement in margins, with the platform supporting the negotiation process and people keeping approval of consequential actions.

projects.title: Enterprise RAG Knowledge Assistant
projects.outcome: Grounded answers from complex technical documentation
projects.summary: A domain-specific knowledge assistant that helps engineers and technical specialists search and reason over complex technical documentation.
projects.challenge: Engineers and technical specialists needed a faster way to search and reason over complex turbomachinery documentation.
projects.role: I engineered the assistant's retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, from document ingestion through retrieval, generation, and quality evaluation.
solution: Context-grounded responses generated with Grok through the xAI API
projects.result: Gives engineers and technical specialists an assistant whose answers are grounded in their own technical documentation.

projects.title: DEEP.AI Platform Implementation
projects.outcome: Production RAG chatbot agents for upselling and retention
projects.summary: BCG's generative AI customer management platform, deployed for telecom and B2B clients.
projects.challenge: Telecom and B2B clients wanted to boost upselling and retention using generative AI and real-time customer analytics.
projects.role: I led the deployment of BCG's generative AI customer management platform.
solution: React front end with FastAPI services
LangChain, OpenAI API, and Pinecone for retrieval and generation
Real-time customer analytics and LLM-driven insights
projects.result: Shipped production-grade RAG chatbot agents for B2B knowledge automation workflows.

projects.title: DRUG.AI – Pharma Discovery Platform
projects.summary: An AI-powered analytics platform that helps pharma researchers find drug repurposing candidates.
projects.challenge: Pharma researchers needed to find drug repurposing candidates faster across evolving R&D data schemas.
projects.role: I built and deployed the analytics platform.
solution: Normalized evolving pharma R&D data schemas into a unified model
Graph traversal and NLP to reveal gene-disease relationships

projects.title: Factory of the Future – MFG.AI
projects.summary: Plant modernization with IoT sensors, digital twins, and real-time defect logging automation.
projects.challenge: Manufacturing clients needed to modernize plant operations and replace slow, manual defect logging.
projects.role: I engineered the real-time defect logging automation and integrated it into BCG's Manufacturing AI suite (MFG.AI).
solution: Edge computing with GCP-hosted FastAPI services
React dashboards for predictive maintenance and analytics
projects.result: Cut manual QA time by 50%, and the defect logging system became part of BCG's Manufacturing AI suite.

projects.title: Airline Disruption Optimization Engine
projects.summary: A real-time rerouting engine for handling flight disruptions.
projects.challenge: A major EU airline needed to reroute flights in real time during disruptions to limit losses.
projects.role: I built the rerouting engine and delivered the working MVP.
solution: Real-time rerouting driven by optimization algorithms
Built in Python with D3.js visualization
projects.result: Delivered a working MVP in under a week, mitigating losses during high-impact operational events.

projects.title: Real-Time Manufacturing API Suite
projects.outcome: Reusable, low-latency services built for global deployment
projects.summary: Reusable microservices behind a suite of manufacturing tools.
projects.challenge: Manufacturing workflows needed shared, reusable services that could support a global deployment.
projects.role: I led the architecture and development.
solution: Scalable, low-latency APIs with FastAPI and PostgreSQL
Integration into a larger suite of tools
projects.result: A reusable API suite integrated into a larger set of tools to support global deployment.

projects.title: AI-Powered Inspection Tools
projects.summary: Geospatial mobile apps with predictive AI for nonprofit enforcement teams.
projects.challenge: A nonprofit wanted to deploy field resources more effectively in its enforcement efforts.
projects.role: I created the geospatial mobile apps.
projects.result: Enabled smarter deployment of field resources.

experience.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Systems
experience.description: Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI agents and applications, translating ambiguous business problems into production-grade LLM-powered systems. Architected and built agentic workflows, tool orchestration, and evaluation frameworks hands-on, explored voice and real-time AI solutions, and mentored engineers on forward-deployed delivery standards.

experience.title: AI Expert Coach (Part-Time)
experience.description: Led AI coaching sessions for 800+ small business owners, delivering practical AI education and adoption frameworks for non-technical audiences. Advised on emerging AI trends and integrated AI-assisted and automation tools into daily business workflows.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
experience.description: Managed and mentored global engineering teams of 15+ while staying hands-on in the architecture and delivery of enterprise AI solutions across telecom, manufacturing, and healthcare. Served as Global Topic Lead for Rapid Prototyping, led system design reviews, and shipped production RAG chatbot agents, a drug repurposing analytics platform (~32% faster research turnaround), and defect logging automation for MFG.AI (50% less manual QA time).

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
experience.description: Led Agile teams and established CI/CD pipelines and automated testing while building microservices-based automation platforms and real-time decision systems for Fortune 500 clients. Built airline disruption rerouting, AI-powered patent analytics, contract spend dashboards, and inventory automation that delivered millions in client savings.

experience.title: Earlier BCG Roles
experience.description: The first part of a 33-year BCG career spanning several roles, ahead of the engineering leadership roles above.

experience.title: Director of Software Engineering (Part-Time)
experience.description: Designed and maintained custom software systems for studio operations, including scheduling, billing, and CRM integrations. Applied full-stack engineering and cloud infrastructure to support business growth.

creative.title: Creative AI Experiments
creative.intro: I like exploring AI beyond enterprise software, too. These side projects are where I try new generative tools and bring some creativity to the technology.

film.title: Director.exe – AI Film Project
film.description: A fully AI-crafted narrative comedy about an artificial director losing control of its own dramatic masterpiece, built with a suite of generative tools for writing, video, imagery, voice, and music. It comes with a healthy dose of humor and glitch.
